name: Acknowledge an achievement celebration
description: Acknowledge an achievement celebration Clears a pending celebration for the given track and stage once the client has shown it, so it isn't celebrated again. POST /api/projects/{project_id}/web_analytics_achievements/acknowledge_celebration/
context:
POST /api/projects/{project_id}/web_analytics_achievements/acknowledge_celebration/
Clears a pending celebration for the given track and stage once the client has shown it, so it isn't celebrated again. Idempotent.
